analyst_view.overall: Early view: two big names in trouble. Feyenoord are 32nd with 3 points after a 3-0 home defeat by Inter, while Porto (26th, 3 points) got their campaign going by beating Napoli 4-1, with three of the goals headed in. With both near the cut-off for the play-off places, neither side can settle for a draw; I found little fresh team news, so the view leans on the matchday 4 performances.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals and I lean a little higher. Porto just scored four against Napoli, and Feyenoord conceded three at home to Inter without reply. Both teams need a win, which tends to keep the game open late.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.6 corners and I lean slightly higher. Porto's win over Napoli came largely from set pieces, with headed goals from Jan Bednarek and Jakub Kiwior, so they will try to win corners. Feyenoord at home will also push to recover from the Inter defeat.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards and I stay with it. Porto's win over Napoli had seven cards, but most went to a frustrated Napoli side; Feyenoord's defeat by Inter had only two. A tense game between two needy sides fits the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.5 shots and I have nothing that moves it. Both teams will attack, but Feyenoord's home display against Inter was flat, which cancels out some of the expected openness.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10 shots on target. Porto were efficient against Napoli and Feyenoord's defence was opened up by Inter, but Feyenoord's own attack failed to score. I stay with the estimate.
